study.title: Long-term monitoring of mammal communities in the Peneda-Gerês National Park using camera-trap data

focal_taxon.selection_rule: fixed for range-edge expansion relevance, not from site-level camera outcomes
focal_taxon.independent_basis: Torres et al. 2015, Expansion and Current Status of Roe Deer at the Edge of Its Distribution in Portugal, DOI 10.5735/086.052.0508; focal selection is therefore independent of site-level Peneda camera outcomes

response_firewall.bounded_header_scope: first physical CSV record only; bytes after the first CR/LF terminator are discarded without parsing or interpretation

geometry_semantics.coordinate_rule: median WGS84 latitude and longitude across all response-independent deployments sharing a locationID

temporal_semantics.endpoint: monthly observed zero-to-detected reappearance at a stable camera location
temporal_semantics.final_win_rule: strict majority of response-independent heldout calendar blocks; exact integer frozen after effort preflight and before any row-level response access

paired_endpoint.baseline: same frozen strong learner plus conventional response-independent features
paired_endpoint.augmented: same learner plus same conventional features plus unchanged symmetric_world_support_summary_v1
paired_endpoint.outer_unit_and_win_threshold: three-month heldout calendar blocks; strict-majority win threshold frozen exactly from the response-independent eligible heldout transition registry after preflight

no_rescue_rules: do not open any observation row/value during preflight; only the prospectively bounded first physical header record may be read

do not change node identity, coordinate aggregation, structural targets, monthly effort rule, split, count minima, focal taxon, learner family, learner hyperparameters, score metric, score-unit rule, or Layer-B representation after geometry access
if the geometry/effort preflight fails, close this attempt without row-level response access
after any row-level response access, no parser repair, retry, endpoint change, row filtering rule change, or candidate-specific rescue is permitted
